title: Mishlove's eleven-year study of Ted Owens
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Mishlove's eleven-year study of Ted Owens, about 1976-1987 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I worked with Owens for 11 years from 1976 to 1987 when he died. [laughter]

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove is a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychic claims. On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, he says he worked with a man named Ted Owens for eleven years, from 1976 until Owens died in 1987, and kept an archive of that work. Mishlove links the study to Hal Puthoff and Russell Targ, two other researchers of psychic abilities, and tells it because he says Owens's abilities deserve serious study.
